lines: You think Allah is far? He says: I am near.
When you whisper a dua and nothing seems to change, remember this.
Allah says: When My servants ask about Me... indeed, I am near.
I respond to the call of the one who calls, when he calls upon Me.
Not far. Near. Call Him today, in your own words. Send this to someone who needs it.
Full movie of Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, whose dua was answered: link below.

beats.text: You think Allah is far? He says: I am near.
beats.ur: آپ سمجھتے ہیں اللہ دور ہے؟ وہ فرماتا ہے: میں قریب ہوں

beats.text: A whispered dua… and nothing seems to change?
beats.ur: آہستہ سے دعا… اور کچھ بدلتا نظر نہیں آتا؟

beats.en: And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near
I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me

beats.text: Not far. Near. Call Him today, in your own words. Send this to someone who needs it.
beats.ur: دور نہیں، قریب۔ آج اپنے الفاظ میں اسے پکاریں۔ یہ اس تک پہنچائیں جسے ضرورت ہے

beats.text: Full movie of Prophet Sulaiman (AS), whose dua was answered: link below.
beats.ur: حضرت سلیمان علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم دیکھیں، جن کی دعا قبول ہوئی، لنک نیچے

scenes.style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. Quiet, intimate, hopeful. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, no human figures, no hands, no silhouettes anywhere.

scenes.s1: A small quiet room at night, a prayer rug on the floor lit by one soft beam of moonlight from a window, deep blue darkness around.
scenes.s2: Prayer beads resting on an open window sill at night, a single candle flickering, the dark city far below.
scenes.s3: A vast clear night sky full of stars above a calm desert, one star shining brighter and closer than all the others, soft glow.
scenes.s4: First light of dawn pouring through an open wooden window onto a prayer rug, warm gold light, dust glowing in the air.
scenes.s5: A peaceful sunrise over a quiet old city of domes and minarets, golden light, birds in the sky.
